title.zh: 授予 Bataan Iron and Steel Corporation 设立、维护和运营私人固定点对点、私人海岸、私人航空及陆基、陆上移动无线电台以收发无线电报文的特许权法案
title.en: An Act Granting the Bataan Iron and Steel Corporation a Franchise to Establish, Maintain and Operate Private Fixed Point-to-Point, Private Coastal, Private Aeronautical and Land-Based and Land-Mobile Radio Stations for the Transmission of Wireless Messages to and from Said Stations

title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Bataan Iron and Steel Corporation để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống phát thanh tại Philippines
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Bataan Iron and Steel Corporation เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบวิทยุกระจายเสียงในฟิลิปปินส์
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Bataan Iron and Steel Corporation untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem penyiaran radio di Filipina
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Bataan Iron and Steel Corporation untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem penyiaran radio di Filipina

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 10 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3115_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Bataan Iron and Steel Corporation is hereby granted a franchise to establish, maintain and operate private fixed point-to-point, private coastal, private aeronautical and land-based and land-mobile radio stations in the City of Manila, in the provinces of Zamboanga del Norte and Zamboanga del Sur, and in such places within the Philippines where it operates its business and/or the interest of its trade and business activities justify, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications, for the transmission and reception of wireless messages on radiotelegraphy or radiotelephony to and from said stations.

This franchise shall continue to be in force for a period of forty-five years and is granted upon the express condition that the same shall be void unless the construction or installation of at least one station be begun within two years from the date of approval of this Act and be completed within four years from said date.
The President of the Philippines shall have the power and authority to permit the location of said private fixed point-to-point, private coastal, private aeronautical and land-based and land-mobile radio stations on any land of the public domain upon such term as he may prescribe.

The grantee shall not engage in domestic business of telecommunications in the Philippines without further assent of the Congress of the Philippines, it being understood that the purpose of this franchise is to secure to the grantee the right to establish, maintain and operate private fixed point-to-point, private coastal, private aeronautical and land-based and land-mobile radio stations at the places hereinabove stated for no other purpose than to promote, protect and subserve the trade and business interests of the grantee.
No fees shall be charged by the grantee as the radio stations that may be established by virtue of this Act shall engage in communications regarding the grantee’s business only.
The grantee shall so construct and operate its stations as not to interfere with the operation of other radio stations maintained and operated in the Philippines.
The grantee is authorized to operate its radio stations on the frequency and/or frequencies that may be assigned to it by Secretary of Public Works and Communications.

A special right is hereby reserved to the President of the Philippines, in time of war, insurrection, public peril, calamity, or disaster to cause the closing of the grantee’s radio stations or to authorize the temporary use or possession thereof by any department of the Government, upon just compensation.

This franchise shall be subject to amendment, alteration, or repeal by the Congress of the Philippines when the public service so requires, and shall not be interpreted as an exclusive grant of the privilege herein provided for.
Whenever in this Act the term "grantee" is used, it shall be held and understood to mean and represent the Bataan Iron and Steel Corporation, its representatives, successors or assigns.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
